title: Letter From The Shanghai Public Safety Bureau Re Mrs. Raissa Korkina-Knight

page_data.en:
Fm. 2
G. 35m-18

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
File No. 4715
SECTION 2 / British / 33
Date January 19, 1933

Subject (in full) Letter from the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau re: Mrs Raissa
Korkina-Knight
Made by D. S. Prokofiev Forwarded by A. D. Smeeton.

With reference to the letter dated January 12, 1933 from
the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau on the subject of Mrs Raissa Kor-
kina-Knight who arrived in Shanghai from Venice on January 3, 1933
by the s.s. " Conte Verde ", and who was suspected by the Chinese
Authorities " of being concerned in some political or irregular
movements", enquiries show that the above suspicion
was based solely on written statements made to the officers of the
Passport Examination Bureau by two Chinese passengers who had ar-
rived in Shanghai by the same vessel.

They stated that Mrs Korkina-Knight had no Chinese visa
when embarking on the s.s. " Conte Verde " at Venice; that while
en-route to Shanghai she made an unsuccessful application for a
visa at the Chinese Consulate in Singapore and that she sent a cable
from Singapore addressed: " Paris - Tardieu". Thinking that the on-
ly person in Paris to whom a telegram can be addressed in this way ,
was Tardieu , the former French Prime Minister, the informants came
to the conclusion that Mrs Korkina-Knight must be an important per-
son and, possibly, was engaged in some political activity. Further
they noticed that she was very nervous about the impending trouble
with the Chinese authorities in Shanghai over the question of visa
and that
she endeavoured, by flirting with the ship officers, to secure
their assistance in this respect. The fact that Mrs Korkina-Knight
seemed to be a fluent speaker of several foreign languages was also
not overlooked by the informants.

On the passenger list Mrs Korkina-Knight's nationality
was stated as French and her address in Shanghai was given as
"C/o Leonard, 35 Verdun Terrace 69 Route Mayen". On the passport
declaration form, however, she stated that she was a Russian and
gave as reference the name of her sister, "rs E. Widler,"

主题（全称）：关于赖莎·科尔基娜-奈特夫人（Mrs Raissa Korkina-Knight）的上海市公安局来函
由 D. S. Prokofiev 撰写，经 A. D. Smeeton 转呈。

兹提及上海市公安局于1933年1月12日发出的信函，内容涉及赖莎·科尔基娜-奈特夫人。该人于1933年1月3日乘“康特·维尔德”号（Conte Verde）轮船从威尼斯抵达上海，被中国当局怀疑“参与某些政治或非法活动”。经查，上述怀疑仅基于两名同船抵达上海的中國乘客向护照查验处官员所作的书面陈述。

他们称，科尔基娜-奈特夫人在威尼斯登上“康特·维尔德”号时未持有中国签证；在前往上海途中，她曾在新加坡的中国领事馆申请签证但未获成功；且她从新加坡发出了一封电报，收件人为：“巴黎 - 塔迪厄（Tardieu）”。举报人认为，在巴黎能以这种方式接收电报的唯一人物是前法国总理塔迪厄，因此得出结论：科尔基娜-奈特夫人必定是一位重要人物，且可能从事某种政治活动。此外，他们还注意到，对于即将因签证问题在上海与中国当局产生的麻烦，她显得非常焦虑，并试图通过向船方官员献媚来争取他们在此事上的协助。举报人也没有忽视科尔基娜-奈特夫人似乎能流利使用多种外语这一事实。

在乘客名单上，科尔基娜-奈特夫人的国籍申报为法国，其在上海的地址列为“转交伦纳德（Leonard），梅恩路69号凡尔登台35号（35 Verdun Terrace 69 Route Mayen）”。然而，在护照申报单上，她声称自己是俄国人，并提供其姐姐“E. Widler 夫人”作为担保人，

bling Well Road. She produced passport No 635, issued by the Bureau
of Foreign Affairs in Shanghai on September 1, 1929. As she had no
Chinese vise she was requested to find two persons in Shanghai who
would furnish a written guarantee as to her character etc., pending
which her luggage was detained at the custom sheds. The guarantee
requested was furnished by Mr. Powell, British, of the Jardine Engi-
neering Corporation, and by Mr and Mrs Emile Vidler, Swiss, 1147 Bub-
bling Well Road, the signatures of the guarantors being certified
by their respective consuls. Mrs Korkina-Knight was then allowed
to take her luggage. The regulations governing the examination of
passports having been complied with, the Chinese authorities seem
to have nothing against Mrs Korkina-Knight. The attached letter
was sent to the Shanghai Municipal Police for information prior
to the settlement of the above incident.
Interviewed by the undersigned on January 15, Mrs Korkina-
Knight stated that she had arrived here from Paris. Shortly before
her departure she applied at the Chinese Consulate in that city
for a passport vise to enable her to proceed to Shanghai, but was
told that it would take about four months to await a reply from
Nanking and that, in the case of application by telegraph, it would
take at least two weeks and the expenses would be about Fr.600.00.
As Mrs Korkina-Knight neither wished to wait nor was inclined to
pay the above sum, she decided to proceed to Shanghai without a
vise, thinking that, as a former resident of Shanghai, she would have
no difficulty in obtaining permission to land here. Further she
stated that while on board the s.s. "Conte Verde" she openly ex-
pressed her poor opinion of the Chinese consular officials in Par-
is and the Chinese race in general. She thinks, therefore, that
this fact might have been reported to the Passport Inspectors in

静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）。她出示了第635号护照，该护照由上海外事局于1929年9月1日签发。由于她没有中国签证，被要求在上海寻找两人为其品行等提供书面担保，在此期间，她的行李被扣留在海关仓库。所要求的担保由怡和工程公司（Jardine Engineering Corporation）的英籍人士鲍威尔先生（Mr. Powell），以及居住在静安寺路1147号的瑞士籍埃米尔·维德勒（Emile Vidler）夫妇提供，担保人的签名均经各自领事认证。随后，科尔基娜-奈特夫人获准取回行李。鉴于已遵守护照查验的相关规定，中国当局似乎对科尔基娜-奈特夫人并无异议。在上述事件解决之前，附函已发送至上海公共租界工部局警务处以供知悉。
科尔基娜-奈特夫人于1月15日接受下文签署人问询时表示，她是自巴黎抵达此处。在离境前不久，她曾向该市的中国领事馆申请护照签证以便前往上海，但被告知等待南京方面的回复约需四个月，若通过电报申请，则至少需两周，费用约为600法郎。由于科尔基娜-奈特夫人既不愿等待，也不愿支付上述金额，她决定在无签证的情况下前往上海，心想作为上海的前居民，她在此获得登陆许可应无困难。此外，她表示在“康特·维尔德”号轮船上，她曾公开表达对巴黎中国领事官员以及对中国种族的负面看法。因此，她认为这一情况可能被一些中国同船乘客报告给了上海的护照检查员。
（批注：我认识鲍威尔先生，他在各方面都可靠？M/S）

Shanghai by some Chinese fellow-passengers. She also mentioned
that she had a French return visa and that she intended to proceed
to France in the near future to join her fiance.

Reference to the registration book of the Russian Emi-
grants Committee, No 6-A Hongkong Road, shows that Raissa Sofronovna
Korkina, Russian, born February 28, 1905, at Vladivostok, arrived here
from Vladivostok in 1911. On January 12, 1923 she was married to
an American named Allen Knight. They left for San Francisco in
1923. In August 1927 Mrs Korkina-Knight returned from the United
States and when registering with the above mentioned body stated
that she had been divorced in San Francisco on September 9, 1927.

Following her arrival here Mrs Korkina-Knight put up at
the Palace Hotel but after a few days removed to No 1147 Bubbling
Well Road, her present address.

Mr. Emil Midler, her brother-in-law and brother of the noto-
rious Elly Midler conducts a business at the above address under
the name of " China Produce Co", Import & Export; Silks, Lingerie, Linen
and Antiques. A shop known as "The Fine Arts", of which Mrs Agnes
Midler is the manageress and which deals in similar goods, is also
situated at the same address ( Flat No I ).

Apart from the above nothing is known to this office re-
garding Mrs Korkin-Knight and her relatives.

（批：yR）

她还提到，她持有法国返程签证，并打算在不久的将来前往法国与未婚夫团聚。

查阅香港路6-A号俄国侨民委员会的登记簿显示，赖莎·索弗罗诺夫娜·科尔基娜（Raissa Sofronovna Korkina），俄国人，1905年2月28日出生于符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴），于1911年从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达此处。1923年1月12日，她与一名名为艾伦·奈特（Allen Knight）的美国人结婚。他们于1923年前往旧金山。1927年8月，科尔基娜-奈特夫人从美国返回，并在向上述机构登记时声明，她已于1927年9月9日在旧金山离婚。

抵达此处后，科尔基娜-奈特夫人初住于宫殿饭店（Palace Hotel），但数日后搬至静安寺路1147号，即其现住址。

她的姐夫、臭名昭著的埃莉·米德勒（Elly Midler）之兄埃米尔·米德勒（Emil Midler）先生，在上述地址以“中国土产公司”（China Produce Co）的名义经营进出口生意，商品包括丝绸、内衣、亚麻制品和古董。一家名为“美术商店”（The Fine Arts）的店铺也位于同一地址（1号公寓），由阿格尼丝·米德勒（Agnes Midler）夫人担任经理，经营类似商品。

除上述情况外，本处对科尔基娜-奈特夫人及其亲属一无所知。

（批注：yR）

G. Piekofies
D.S.

特别科科长。

（批注：登记。请复函总领事，告知此事已记录在案。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Translation of Letter from Shanghai Public Safety Bureau.

No. 28                                          January 12, 1933.

Major Gerrard,
Commissioner of Police,
S. M. P.

Sir,
    On the 3rd inst., a Russian female named
Raissa Kortina Knight arrived at this Port from
Venice per s.s. "Conte Verde". She is in possession
of an improper passport and is now living with her
sister at 1147 Bubbling Well Road. As she is sus-
pected of being concerned in some political or
irregular movements, she will be told to find a
reliable guarantor and come to us to be registered.

    The Italian Mail Steamship Company will be
notified to the effect that passengers, who are not
in possession of bona-fide passports, are not allowed
to travel on their ships to come to China.

    Apart from notifying the French Police, you
are informed as above.

    Attached are two photos of this woman.

                                        Wen Hung En
                                Chief of Public Safety Bureau
                                            Shanghai.

第 28 号                                          1933年1月12日。

致：
杰拉德少校（Major Gerrard），
警务总监，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

先生：
    本月3日，一名名为赖莎·科尔蒂娜·奈特（Raissa Kortina Knight）的俄国女性乘“康特·维尔德”号轮船从威尼斯抵达本埠。她所持护照不合规定，现与其姐同住于静安寺路1147号。因其涉嫌参与某些政治或非法活动，将责令其寻找可靠担保人，并前来我局登记。

    将通知意大利邮船公司，凡未持有真实有效护照之乘客，不得乘坐其船只来华。

    除通知法国警方外，特此知照贵处。

    随函附上该女子照片两张。

                                        文鸿恩
                                上海市公安局局长
                                            上海
